answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Attestations tie to bonded identities, so a false claim traces back to its owner. A new agent's standing glows like an ember, growing only with verified work. Each pulse rechecks a claim, and any whisper of doubt triggers an audit.
